entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey, Futaba... If I was gonna add[n]something to the menu, what[n]would you want it to be?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hmmmmmm... Maybe curry spaghetti![n]And curry udon! Oh, and curry[n]croquettes, and curry pizza!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You really like curry that much...?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Well, I guess it'd be pretty easy given the[n]current menu. I'll give it some thought.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: How about you? Anything you'd[n]wanna add to the menu?
You want my suggestion?
Something with curry.[clr 27]
I can't decide!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Just be sure it's something you[n]can make, okay? You're gonna have[n]to prep the food too, you know.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yeah! Go [fName], go!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You're hooked too, huh?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Of course he is! That stuff's[n]super addicting, man!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Then... what about curry yakisoba!?[n]First, you take a nice big cup of[n]instant yakisoba, then you—

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't be ridiculous. I'm not using[n]instant yakisoba in my cooking.

entries.speaker: Futaba's Uncle
entries.en: Why haven't you answered my calls?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...Leave now, or else I'll be[n]forced to contact the police.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I'm not giving you a penny.

entries.speaker: Futaba's Uncle
entries.en: What was that...?

entries.speaker: Futaba's Uncle
entries.en: Quit fucking with me!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Stop it! Sojiro didn't[n]do anything wrong!

entries.speaker: Futaba's Uncle
entries.en: Shut your mouth, brat! It's[n]your fault I'm in this mess!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Look, Futaba's my daughter. You[n]may be her uncle, but you have[n]no connection to her anymore.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: We can take it to court if you[n]really want. Don't underestimate[n]how hard I'm willing to fight.

entries.speaker: Futaba's Uncle
entries.en: What...!?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Not only do you have massive debt,[n]but I heard you failed in your most[n]recent business venture.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: How do you think the court would[n]respond if they knew how wasteful[n]you were with your money...?

entries.speaker: Futaba's Uncle
entries.en: Goddammit...!

entries.speaker: Futaba's Uncle
entries.en: This is all your fault, you bitch![n]You cursed little...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Eek!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Futaba!

entries.speaker: Futaba's Uncle
entries.en: Hrgh... Urgh...

entries.speaker: Futaba's Uncle
entries.en: Th-This is assault... I'll sue!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What are you talking about? You[n]clearly fell down on your own.

entries.speaker: Futaba's Uncle
entries.en: This delinquent attacked me![n]He's dangerous!

entries.speaker: Futaba's Uncle
entries.en: This café's finished, you hear me!?[n]I won't let you get away with this!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: *sigh*

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: God damn... What a pain in the ass.[n]Don't you have enough problems already?
I didn't do anything wrong.
I was just protecting Futaba.[clr 27]
I'm sorry.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I know you didn't...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Are you okay, Futaba?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Mm-hm...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But Uncle said he's gonna sue...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Nobody said you did anything[n]wrong. To be honest, it should've[n]been me trying to stop him...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Mm-hm...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But Uncle said he's gonna sue...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't apologize, it just makes[n]me look bad. I should've been[n]the one trying to stop him...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Mm-hm...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But Uncle said he's gonna sue...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't worry...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: No matter what ends up happening[n]to me or this store, I won't let[n]them lay a finger on you two.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I'm your guardian, after all.[n]I have a duty to protect the both of you.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: So don't go doing anything like[n]that again, you hear? I appreciate[n]the spirit you showed though.
I feel like my bond with[n]Sojiro is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Anyway, I'm done for the day.[n]Take care of closing up for me.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Let's go, Futaba.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: [fName]...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'll message you later...
